hebrewText: וְ/עַתָּה֙ הָלֹ֣ךְ הָלַ֔כְתָּ כִּֽי נִכְסֹ֥ף נִכְסַ֖פְתָּה לְ/בֵ֣ית אָבִ֑י/ךָ לָ֥/מָּה גָנַ֖בְתָּ אֶת אֱלֹהָֽ/י

tokens.bdb: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive

tokens.bdb: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)

tokens.bdb: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
